exploit_name: Global variable manipulation during active draw alters end result
description: Critical parameters (protocol fee, referral fee, entropy provider, payout calculator, LP manager) can be modified after ticket purchases but before settlement.
root_cause: Critical parameters (protocol fee, referral fee, entropy provider, payout calculator, LP manager) can be modified after ticket purchases but before settlement.
fix_description: Implement parameter-freezing logic preventing configuration changes while a draw is active.
notes: Owners can manipulate winnings, redirect funds, cause settlement denial.
